content: समुदित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Gone up, risen, ascended. .²2 Lofty, elevated; prospered; कञ्चित् समुदितां स्फीतामयोध्यां परिरक्षसे <ls>Rām. 2. 100. 42</ls>. .²3 Produced, arisen, occasioned. .²4 Assembled, collected, united; मद्भाग्योपचयादयं समुदितः सर्वो गुणानां गणः <ls>Ratn. 1. 6</ls>. .²5 Possessed of, furnished with; सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः <ls>Rām. 1. 18. 13</ls>. .²6 Conversed. .²7 Spoken to, addressed. .²8 Agreed upon. .²9 Customary, usual.
